At Four Seasons Resort Maldives at Kuda Huraa, a short dhoni ride from the main jetty leads to ŪRJĀ, a naturopathy island named after the Sanskrit word for vitality. Four Seasons unveiled it in August 2026, and Hotel Designs explored it in November.

## How it works

Each stay begins with a naturopathic consultation, with optional micronutrient scans, iris diagnosis and postural mapping. Guests then follow one of four pathways: Rest & Rebalance, Cleanse, Nourish and Reconnect.

Over-water treatment suites host mud therapy, heliotherapy, sound healing, magneto therapy and life-force healing, as well as yoga therapy, fasting, acupuncture and a Night Spa Ritual. Onsite naturopathic doctors run specialised programmes for sleep, liver detox and joint care.

Many treatments use AION A, a mineral found in an ancient Roman quarry in Würenlos, Switzerland, by the Swiss naturopathic researcher Emma Kunz. Her geometric drawings illustrate the treatment menu.

## The signal

Wellness is moving from the spa menu to the whole destination. Resorts no longer add a treatment room; they give healing its own island, its own boat and its own doctors.
summary: At Four Seasons Resort Maldives at Kuda Huraa, ŪRJĀ is a naturopathy island reached by dhoni, with over-water treatment suites and four healing pathways.
